entities.summary: Iberian, a notable figure in the history of Georgia, associated with Roman-Iranian Contested Georgia (117–337). Preceded by Iberian Kings and Dual Suzerainty and Pompey. Their legacy influenced King Mirian III adopts Christianity as state religion of Iberia.
